name: Start Webserver Mixed Architecture
description: Runtime architecture for make start-webserver-mixed. It starts the Vault-backed, bearer-token-protected HTTPS repository endpoint and an independent unauthenticated HTTPS nginx endpoint together.

nodes.name: Architect
nodes.description: A local operator who starts the mixed stack and requests CALM artifacts from either the authenticated or unauthenticated HTTPS endpoint.

nodes.name: CALM CLI
nodes.description: The local CALM CLI using the custom-idp v3 direct URL auth module to obtain a bearer token for eligible HTTPS repository requests.

nodes.name: Static Content Tree (HTTPS Auth)
nodes.description: The static_authcerts repository content tree mounted read-only into the authenticated nginx service.

nodes.name: Static Content Tree (Anonymous HTTPS)
nodes.description: The static_http repository content tree mounted read-only into nginx-noauth and served without authentication.

nodes.name: TLS Certificate Bundle
nodes.description: The generated local certificate and private key mounted into both nginx services for TLS termination and into oauth2-proxy for issuer trust.

nodes.name: Direct URL Auth v3 Config
nodes.description: The generated custom-idp/v3 configuration that identifies the Keycloak token endpoint and the Vault secret lookup used for authenticated HTTPS requests.

nodes.name: Vault Direct URL Secret
nodes.description: The local Vault KV secret at secret/data/calm/direct-url containing the Keycloak machine-client secret.

nodes.name: Authenticated Nginx
nodes.description: The nginx Compose service that serves static_authcerts over HTTPS on port 8443 and delegates protected-content checks to oauth2-proxy.

nodes.name: Unauthenticated Nginx
nodes.description: The independent nginx-noauth Compose service that serves static_http and the anonymous /healthz endpoint over HTTPS on port 8080.

nodes.name: OAuth2 Proxy
nodes.description: The oauth2-proxy service that validates bearer tokens or OIDC sessions before authenticated nginx serves protected static content.

nodes.name: Keycloak Identity Provider
nodes.description: The Keycloak service that issues client-credentials access tokens and provides OIDC identity services for the authenticated HTTPS path.

nodes.name: HashiCorp Vault
nodes.description: The Vault dev service that exposes the local KV API on port 8200 for the custom-idp v3 secret lookup.

nodes.name: YOUR-CALM.REPO
nodes.description: The unauthenticated HTTPS runtime within the mixed Compose startup.

nodes.name: MY-CALM.REPO
nodes.description: The Vault-backed authenticated HTTPS runtime within the mixed Compose startup.

relationships.description: Run CALM validation or another local repository request.
The direct URL auth module reads its generated v3 configuration before an eligible authenticated request.
The v3 direct URL auth module reads the machine-client secret from the local Vault API.
Vault stores the machine-client secret at secret/data/calm/direct-url.
The v3 direct URL auth module requests a client-credentials access token from Keycloak after reading the Vault secret.
The CALM CLI requests repository content through HTTPS with the bearer token obtained by the v3 direct URL auth module.
The CALM CLI can request public repository content or /healthz through the independent HTTPS endpoint without authentication.
Authenticated nginx serves repository artifacts from the mounted static_authcerts tree.
nginx-noauth serves repository artifacts from the mounted static_http tree.
Authenticated nginx terminates HTTPS with the generated local TLS certificate and private key.
Unauthenticated nginx terminates HTTPS with the generated local TLS certificate and private key.
Authenticated nginx delegates protected-content authorization checks and OAuth callback handling to oauth2-proxy.
oauth2-proxy validates local bearer tokens and OIDC identity data against Keycloak.
YOUR-CALM.REPO contains the unauthenticated nginx service and its static content tree.
MY-CALM.REPO contains the remaining authenticated runtime services and their supporting assets.

flows.name: Fetch Protected HTTPS Content
flows.description: The CALM CLI loads its v3 auth configuration, retrieves the client secret from Vault, obtains a Keycloak bearer token, and fetches protected static content over HTTPS.

transitions.description: The operator invokes a CALM command.
The CLI loads direct URL auth configuration.
The auth module reads the machine-client secret.
The auth module obtains a client-credentials access token.
The CLI retrieves a protected artifact with its bearer token.

flows.name: Fetch Public HTTPS Content
flows.description: An operator directly fetches static_http content or the anonymous health endpoint through the independent HTTPS nginx service; this path does not involve Vault, Keycloak, or oauth2-proxy.

transitions.description: The CALM CLI requests public content or /healthz over HTTPS.
nginx-noauth reads the requested artifact from static_http.
